bCV0bHwob6k.description:
Full episode: https://youtu.be/cpmOqGi1Nqw

The claim being tested: 25 claims people repeat as fact. We looked up the study each one came from, then looked up what happened when somebody ran it again.

26 claims, 117,306 people in the replications
  12 gone
  4 smaller, still there
  1 went the other way
  9 held up
9 of 26 held up.

Source: FORRT Replication Database (FReD), osf.io/2tbvd

_jSrEYCgU8E.title: Power posing: they measured 4 things. 1 came back.
_jSrEYCgU8E.description:
The full episode goes up on this channel.

Does standing in a powerful pose make you more powerful?

What the replication found:
  felt more powerful   d = +0.34  p = 0.017  significant
  testosterone         d = -0.20  p = 0.162  not significant
  cortisol             d = -0.16  p = 0.272  not significant
  risk taking          d = -0.18  p = 0.215  not significant
1 of 4 came back.

Source: Assessing the Robustness of Power Posing: No Effect on Hormones and Risk Tolerance in a Large Sample of Men and Women (doi:10.1177/0956797614553946)
#Shorts

CJdPBbB-lP0.title: Learning styles: they measured 3 things. 2 came back.
CJdPBbB-lP0.description:
Full episode: https://youtu.be/m14CWlRhpvA

Do you learn better when you are taught in your own style?

What the replication found:
  teaching to their style    F(1, 38) = 1.16  p = 0.290  not significant
  listening beat reading, for everyone F(1, 110) = 4.92, eta2 = 0.04  p = 0.030  significant
  visual types scored higher at both F(1, 32) = 12.92, eta2 = 0.29  p = 0.001  significant
2 of 3 came back.

Source: Providing Instruction Based on Students' Learning Style Preferences Does Not Improve Learning (doi:10.3389/fpsyg.2020.00164)
#Shorts
